strandNote: HL10 section 2: the eight parallel ladders the curriculum runs. Every node declares exactly one. FUNCTION and TEXT are fully universal across tracks; GRAMMAR, SOUND and ETYMOLOGY are universal SLOTS filled per language; CULTURE and IDIOM are universal HOOKS whose content is entirely local. A strand with zero nodes is not an oversight to be hidden -- it is the measurement that the strand exists as an aspiration rather than a commitment.
